generations.prompt: Choirling, a small hooded chorister spirit monster for a JRPG side-view battle, standing, facing right. Tall pointed violet hood and long flowing purple robe, round pale bone-white mask face with small dark eyes and a small open singing mouth, tiny pale hand in front, a little gold sparkle note floating in front of it. Idle stance. Large sprite that fills the canvas height. Clean readable pixel art sprite with dark outline, single character centred, robe hem at the bottom, transparent background.
idle loop: robe sways gently, the floating gold sparkle in front of it twinkles and bobs, feet stay in place
note burst attack: leans back and takes a breath, then sings forward to the right, a burst of gold music notes shoots out from its mouth, then it straightens up
casting a hymn: raises both hands upward and sings, glowing violet rings and gold notes swirl around it, then it lowers its hands
taking a hit: recoils backwards to the left, the mask face winces with eyes shut, hood tilts back, then recovers
death: wobbles, the robe crumples and collapses downward into a flat empty heap, the mask falls onto the pile, then it fades
